slides.headline: CARGO AND RECORDS MOVE SEPARATELY
slides.body: Cargo and its records can move through separate operational channels.
slides.visual_concept: Freight operator beside cargo documents and a truck.
image_queries: East Africa freight operator cargo documents

slides.headline: SEPARATE CHANNELS HOLD SEPARATE COPIES
slides.body: Email, messaging and operations folders may contain separate document copies.
slides.visual_concept: Three dated shipping document copies arranged on a desk.
image_queries: dated shipping document copies office desk

slides.headline: SEVERAL TEAMS USE THE CARGO RECORD
slides.body: Operations, documentation and clearing teams each work around the cargo record.
slides.visual_concept: Three freight roles connected around one cargo record.
image_queries: East Africa freight operations team office

slides.headline: INCONSISTENT DOCUMENT STATES
slides.body: Documents and validation states must reconnect around the cargo record to ensure accuracy.
slides.visual_concept: A cargo record with documents and validation states being updated in sync.
image_queries: cargo record with documents and validation states
documents and validation states being updated in sync

slides.body: Example Company provides one operational control layer for cargo, documents, milestones and client visibility.
